notes.title: Tales of Therapy Update 1.04
notes.notes:
We have added, revised, and improved numerous small graphical elements and created a new cutscene for the game over!

Here is the list of improvements:

1) New Game Over Screen with a Cutscene: A fresh cutscene now plays when the game over screen appears, adding more emotional weight.

2) Improved Graphics and Bug Fixes: Enhanced visual details and fixed several minor bugs.

3) Added NPCs and Dialogue: New NPCs have been introduced across various areas, along with fresh lines of dialogue.

4) New Key Item Descriptions: Key items now come with more detailed descriptions.

5) Improved Ship Animations at Exitum Port: Ship animations at the Exitum port have been refined.

6) Enhanced Snow Textures: Snow textures have been improved for a more immersive atmosphere.

7) Gray Filter in Flashbacks and Memories: Flashbacks and memory sequences now feature a nostalgic gray filter.

8) Map Design: Some maps have been redesigned to improve visual flow and exploration.
